Thanks — looping in a short technical note so ClearBank can pre-flight firewall config.

High-level requirements (pre-cutover):
- Outbound IPs: 34.120.10.0/24, 34.120.11.0/24 (these are egress ranges for the staging->prod transfer)
- TLS: 1.2+ required, mutual TLS not required for the initial release but recommended for subsequent rollouts
- Ports: 443 (HTTPS), 5671 (AMQP over TLS) if using our broker, 9411 (tracing) — please confirm with your network team
- PTR/DNS: ensure reverse DNS entries exist for the agents that will be updating records during cutover

I've attached a short PDF with the exact questions we normally hand to network teams: network-firewall-questions.pdf (pdf). If ClearBank can confirm the egress CIDRs and open 443/5671 in advance, we'll be in a much better position for a quick verification during the call.

Also can you share the contact for your on-call network engineer so we can call directly if needed during the exercise?
